algorithm_recommendations.MD5: Upgrade to SHA-256 or SHA-3; MD5 is cryptographically broken (collision attacks).
algorithm_recommendations.3DES: Replace 3DES with AES-256; 3DES is deprecated (NIST SP 800-131A) and slated for removal.
algorithm_recommendations.RC4: Replace RC4 with ChaCha20 or AES-GCM.
algorithm_recommendations.Blowfish: Migrate to AES-256 or Twofish; Blowfish's 64-bit block size is vulnerable to birthday-bound attacks (e.g. SWEET32) on large data volumes.
algorithm_recommendations.SHA224: Consider upgrading to SHA-256 for a larger security margin unless SHA-224's shorter digest is a specific interoperability requirement.

binary_security_recommendations.writable_executable_section: Enable W^X (write XOR execute) memory protection; no memory region should be simultaneously writable and executable.
binary_security_recommendations.debug_symbols_present: Strip debug symbols before production release (e.g. `strip --strip-debug`).
binary_security_recommendations.high_entropy: Investigate the cause of unusually high binary entropy (packing, obfuscation, or embedded encrypted/compressed payloads) before shipping to production.
binary_security_recommendations.missing_symbols: Verify the binary was stripped intentionally; an unexpectedly fully-stripped binary can also indicate tampering and should be validated against a known-good build.
binary_security_recommendations.suspicious_imports: Review usage of unsafe/dangerous library functions (e.g. system, strcpy, gets) and replace them with bounds-checked or parameterized alternatives.
binary_security_recommendations.hardcoded_crypto_constants: If cryptographic keys or secrets are embedded directly in the binary, store them in a secure hardware element (TPM/HSM/Secure Enclave) or an encrypted key store instead.
binary_security_recommendations.weak_compiler_protections: Recompile with stack-protection enabled (e.g. `-fstack-protector-strong`) and verify the toolchain's default hardening flags are active.
binary_security_recommendations.large_executable_surface: Consider modularizing the binary to reduce its attack surface, and enable link-time dead-code elimination.
binary_security_recommendations.missing_relocation_protection: Recompile as a Position-Independent Executable (`-fPIE -pie`) to enable ASLR.

firmware_metadata_recommendations.unknown_compiler: Rebuild with a known, tracked toolchain so the build provenance and available hardening flags can be verified.
firmware_metadata_recommendations.old_compiler: Upgrade the build toolchain; older compilers may lack modern hardening defaults (stack protectors, PIE-by-default, CFI).
firmware_metadata_recommendations.architecture_mismatch: Confirm the firmware was built for its intended target architecture; an unexpected or unrecognized architecture value should be investigated before deployment.
firmware_metadata_recommendations.missing_metadata: Ensure build metadata (compiler identity, architecture, build configuration) is preserved and recorded for future auditability.
firmware_metadata_recommendations.firmware_age: This firmware build is old; re-evaluate it against currently known vulnerabilities and consider a rebuild against current dependencies.

deprecated_algorithm_generic_recommendat: This firmware uses a deprecated cryptographic algorithm; migrate to a currently-recommended alternative (see the algorithm-specific recommendation) as soon as practical.
